answer: Propose a chip gate for agents paid to signal jade arrivals at a jetty. Each physical chip has one issuer-certified serial, reserved to one key/day. Ledger validators verify certificates, fresh key/day-bound chip signatures and serial uniqueness; failure denies payment. Shared hosts and parallel keys cannot reuse serials. Chips are reusable capital; rental or power recurs, no stake. Issuer fraud defeats scarcity; wealthy owners can buy aliases. This does not prove signal accuracy. Ten concurrent keys require ten chips, not ten processes.
